{{search|island in Pokémon the Movie 2000|the dungeon in Pokémon Super Mystery Dungeon|Fire Island Volcano}} {{missing image|needs=Proper location map}} {{Infobox island |island=Fire Island |characters=火の島 |japanese=Fire Island |image=Fire Island.png |imagesize=250px |epnumber=M02 |eptitle=The Power of One |map=Shamouti.png }} '''Fire Island''' (Japanese: '''火の島''' ''Fire Island'') is an island in the central [[Orange Islands]], featured in the [[M02|second movie]]. [[File:Fire Island shrine.png|thumb|250px|left|The Fire Island shrine]] Fire Island is the southeastern one of the three elemental islands, and is the home of the {{pkmn2|Legendary}} {{DL|Legendary birds (M02)|Moltres}}. The island has a small volcano in the center of the island as well as a forest on one side of the island and rocky shorelines on the other. {{Ash}} visited Fire Island first in his quest to fulfill the Legend Festival's {{DL|Myths and legends involving Legendary and Mythical Pokémon|Shamouti Island|Chosen One myth}}. He soon obtained the Fire Treasure, a glowing orb located in a small altar that overlooks a volcanic crater. [[Lawrence III]] had already captured {{p|Moltres}} prior, but returned to Fire Island to capture {{p|Zapdos}}, which moved to Fire Island soon after to claim the area that Moltres had seemingly abandoned. Inadvertently, he also captured {{Ash}}, {{an|Misty}}, {{Tracey}}, {{AP|Pikachu}}, {{OBP|Melody|M02}}, and {{TRT}}, whose boat was of similar size to the legendary birds, and brought them aboard his airship. After Ash placed all three of island treasures at the [[Shamouti Island]] shrine, peace was restored and Moltres returned to Fire Island. ==Pokémon seen on Fire Island== {| style="margin:auto; width: 50%" |- | {{ActivePoké|Fire Island|Moltres|Moltres M02.png|Fire|Flying|link=Legendary birds (M02)}} | |} ==In other languages== {{langtable|color={{orange color light}}|bordercolor={{orange color}} |zh_yue=火之島 ''{{tt|Fó jī Dóu|Fire Island}}'' |zh_cmn=火之島 / 火之岛 ''{{tt|Huǒ zhī Dǎo|Fire Island}}'' |fi=Tulisaari |fr=Île de Feu |de= |it=Isola del Fuoco |es= |pl=Wyspa Ognia }} {{-}} ==Related articles== {{Orange Islands}}
